notes: *"Can we review the performance and see what is the root cause of the long response time."* The root cause The same statements are fetched from four independent places, and fmp.js had no cache — the Map at the top of the governor is a rate-limit bucket, not a store. | Caller | Fetches | How often | | pricing/context.js | income + balance + cashflow (annual, 2) | once per name | | pricing/reconstruct.js | the same three at limit ~40 | once per intrinsic frame (~6) | | series.js | a statement endpoint at limit 40 | once per band: series (~6 relative frames) | | pricing/basis.js | profile + incom
